responsibility: Declares the entry point for the Rust readonly-write checking pass that operates on GCC trees after lowering. It exposes ReadonlyCheck::Lint(Compile::Context&) as the interface through which the Rust frontend asks this backend-oriented diagnostics pass to inspect collected declarations and function bodies for writes to readonly locations.
same_name_distinction: Declares the ReadonlyCheck entry point as a small interface in the errors directory, exposing static Lint(Compile::Context&); unlike the .cc file, it does not define the tree traversal or readonly diagnostic behavior.
